authority: Alabama Licensing Board for General Contractors (commercial/GC, incl. subcontractor specialties); residential builders and roofers are licensed separately by the Alabama Home Builders Licensure Board
approx_rows: approx 10,500 (the board site says 10,594 current licensees; I did not count the rows in the file)
notes: Linked as 'Download License Verification List' from https://licensesearch.alabama.gov/genconbd. I checked the headers and the header row only. Columns: Name, License_Number, Address, City, State, Zip, Phone_Number, fax, Bid_Limit, Specialty, Expiration_Date, Extension_Date. The file has no status or county column and no qualifier name. It appears to hold current licensees only (not verified). The search page gives specialty codes (BC, E, M, H/RR, HS, MU, D, EV, SP, SC, and sub-codes such as BC-S) but links no separate code list. Residential: the Home Builders Licensure Board (hblb.alabama.gov) offers only a lookup form at https://alhobv7prod.glsuite.us/GLSuiteWeb/Clients/ALHOB/Public/LicenseeSearch.aspx, which returned 403 to me. Its /licensees/ page confirms search only, with no bulk file.

authority: Alabama Real Estate Commission (AREC)
approx_rows: not_established
notes: List download service, also reachable via https://alabamainteractive.org/arecdownload/welcome.action. Lists offered: Company/Personnel, Licensee List ('Licensees with home address information', filter Active/Inactive/Both), Exam, Schools, Instructors, Exam Registration. Data refreshes monthly. The page does not state the file format or the full field list. The free lookup is at https://arec.alabama.gov/apps/LicenseSearch.

authority: Alaska Dept. of Commerce, Community & Economic Development, Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing (CBPL), Construction Contractors program
file_format: csv (ProfessionalLicenseDownload.csv; one file for all professional-licence programs)
approx_rows: not_established
notes: Linked from the 'Database Downloads' section of https://www.commerce.alaska.gov/cbp/main/Search. The site sits behind DataDome bot protection: curl and WebFetch got 403, but it loaded in a real browser. I read only the header row: Program, ProfType, LicenseNum, DBA, Owners, Status, DateIssued, DateEffective, DateExpired, ADDRESS1, ADDRESS2, CITY, STATE, ZIP. Filter by Program. Relevant programs: 'Construction Contractors', 'Residential Contractor Endorsement', 'Electrical Administrators', 'Mechanical Administrators'. 'Owners' holds owner or entity names, not a qualifier. There is no county column. A separate Endorsement Download and Business License Download are also on that page.

authority: Alaska Real Estate Commission, administered by the Division of Corporations, Business and Professional Licensing (DCCED)
file_format: csv (the same statewide professional-licence file as the contractor row)
approx_rows: not_established
notes: Same file as the Alaska contractor row. Filter Program = 'Real Estate' or 'Real Estate Office'; the ProfType column holds the licence type. Bot-protected by DataDome, so a browser is needed. There is no county column.

authority: Arizona Registrar of Contractors (ROC)
file_format: csv (separate Commercial and Residential posting-list files)
approx_rows: not_established (search-engine snippets, not verified: Commercial approx 42,500, Residential approx 44,300)
notes: roc.az.gov is behind a Cloudflare bot check. WebFetch, curl and the browser all got 403 or 'Performing security verification', so I could not confirm anything. Search results index dated files such as https://roc.az.gov/sites/default/files/ROC_Posting-List_Commercial_2024-08-12.csv and ROC_Posting-List_Residential_2025-02-23.csv, which suggests the filename changes with each posting. Snippets claim licence number, business name, class, address, qualifying party, issue/expiry dates and status, but none of that is verified, so fields are left empty. Lookup form: https://azroc.my.site.com/AZRoc/s/contractor-search. Needs a manual browser visit to confirm the current file and its columns.

authority: Arizona Department of Real Estate (ADRE)
file_format: csv (generated on demand; List 1 = Individual Licenses, List 2 = Entity Licenses at /PdbWeb/List/DownloadList/2)
approx_rows: not_established
cadence: unknown (lists are generated on demand, so appear current)
notes: Index page: http://services.azre.gov/PdbWeb/List/ViewLists. I read the first bytes only. Individual columns: LastName, FirstName, MiddleName, OriginalDate, ExpireDate, LicNumber, LicCategory, LicType, LicStatus, EmploymentType, EmployerLegalName, EmployerDBAName, EmployerLicNumber, EmployerPhone, EmployerFax, MailingAddress1/2, MailingCity/State/Zip, MailingCounty, LastModified. The Entity file adds DesignatedBrokerLicNumber and County. Lists 4 (Public Reports) and 5 (Schools) also exist.

authority: Arkansas Contractors Licensing Board (Dept. of Labor and Licensing): commercial and residential (incl. home improvement) divisions
file_format: csv (~6.2 MB; first line is a title row 'CLB Roster Export - <date>' before the header)
approx_rows: approx 15,000 (my estimate from file size; rows not counted)
cadence: daily (the search page says 'A complete roster is generated nightly')
notes: Linked from http://aclb2.arkansas.gov/clbsearch.php, which serves over HTTP only (HTTPS refused). Header: ID, CommResid (C/R), Name, DBA, Address, City, State, Zip, Email, Country, Phone, Restricted Projects Under 750000, Bid Limit, license, Div Comment, Exp, Class Desc, Spec, Style, Registration, Temporary, County, Officers. 'Officers' lists named officers, not a formal qualifier, so qualifier_name is only approximate. There is no explicit status column; the file appears to be current licensees (not verified). The file includes email addresses, which is a redistribution and privacy consideration. Electrical and HVAC/R are on separate DOL&L rosters (labor.arkansas.gov/resources/rosters/).

authority: Arkansas Real Estate Commission (AREC), Dept. of Labor and Licensing
approx_rows: not_established
notes: The page I fetched, https://arec.arkansas.gov/online-services/, offers only the Real Estate Agent Roster Search. The old ark.org URL 301-redirects to the agent-search page above, which I did not fetch. No bulk or paid list was found on the official pages. Whether a list is available by public-records request is not established.

authority: Contractors State License Board (CSLB)
file_format: csv or xls (ASP.NET postback download: choose 'License Master', then the CSV/Excel link; there is no static file URL)
approx_rows: not_established (a search snippet claims 700,000+ for the full file; not verified)
notes: Public Data Portal with three files: License Master (renewed licences plus expired-but-renewable; excludes cancelled, revoked and expired-non-renewable), Workers' Compensation, and Personnel (names, titles, classifications; this is where qualifiers live). Fields are from the portal's description; I did not download the file. The code list gives the A, B, B-2, C-xx classifications. A paid full/update-file order form also exists (FULL_FILE_-_UPDATE_FILE_ORDER_FORM.pdf; not fetched).

authority: California Department of Real Estate (DRE)
approx_rows: not_established
terms: free; the separate Examinee list is use-restricted (Civ. Code 1798.61(b)); nothing I read restricts the licensee list
notes: Index page: https://www.dre.ca.gov/Licensees/ExamineeLicenseeListDataFiles.html. It also offers broker_associates_list.xls and mlo_list.xls (daily) and new_licensees.xls and ExamineeList.xls (weekly, Mondays). Field layout is in form RE 776 (https://www.dre.ca.gov/files/pdf/forms/re776.pdf), which I fetched but could not extract text from, so fields are not established. I checked the zip headers only, not its contents.

authority: Colorado Dept. of Regulatory Agencies (DORA), Division of Professions and Occupations: State Electrical Board and State Plumbing Board
file_format: Socrata dataset (csv/json via SODA API); dataset id 7s5z-vewr, 'Professional and Occupational Licenses in Colorado'
approx_rows: approx 1,610,000 across all DPO professions; trade subset e.g. licensetype EC approx 12,500, PC approx 5,400
terms: free (portal notes 'intended for research purposes only')
notes: DORA's official page (https://dora.colorado.gov/consumer-protection-home-and-repair) says: 'Not all occupations are licensed, such as roofers and general contractors.' General contractors are licensed locally by cities and counties. At state level only electrical and plumbing trades are licensed; per DORA's site, HVAC and roofing are not. The dataset uses bare licensetype codes (EC, PC, ME, MP, JW, RW, etc.) with no published decode. I believe EC = electrical contractor and PC = plumbing contractor, but did not verify it. Address is city/state/zip only, with no street or county. Columns: names, entityname, city, state, mailzipcode, licensetype, subcategory, licensenumber, first issue/last renewed/expiration dates, licensestatusdescription, discipline fields.

authority: Colorado Division of Real Estate (DORA)
file_format: Socrata dataset (csv/json via SODA API); dataset id 4zse-6bnw, 'Licensed Real Estate Professionals in Colorado'
approx_rows: approx 110,300 (includes appraisers, MLOs, HOAs, companies); brokers approx 50,000 across the broker licence types
notes: Colorado has no 'salesperson' licence; types are broker levels (Associate, Employing, Independent). licensetype holds readable names. Address is city/state/zipcode only, with no street or county. Also has licenseprefix and discipline columns (casenumber, programaction, dates).

authority: Connecticut Dept. of Consumer Protection (DCP), Occupational & Professional Licensing (HIC, NHC and trades); Major Contractor registration is by the Dept. of Administrative Services (DAS)
file_format: Socrata dataset (csv/json via SODA API); dataset id ngch-56tr, 'State Licenses and Credentials'
approx_rows: approx 2,666,000 across all credentials; HOME IMPROVEMENT CONTRACTOR approx 135,400, NEW HOME CONSTRUCTION CONTRACTOR approx 16,000, MAJOR CONTRACTOR approx 5,200 (all statuses)
notes: Connecticut has no general-contractor licence based on competency. What it has: Home Improvement Contractor registration, New Home Construction Contractor registration, and Major Contractor registration for large commercial and structural work. All three are registrations in this dataset. Licensed trades are also here: electrical, plumbing and piping, heating/piping/cooling, sheet metal, fire protection, elevator, solar and others. Columns: credentialid, name, type, businessname, dba, fullcredentialcode, credentialtype, credentialnumber, credentialsubcategory, credential, status, statusreason, active, issuedate, effectivedate, expirationdate, address, city, state, zip, recordrefreshedon. There is no county or qualifier column.

authority: Connecticut Dept. of Consumer Protection (Real Estate Commission)
approx_rows: REAL ESTATE BROKER approx 21,800; REAL ESTATE SALESPERSON approx 97,500 (all statuses)
notes: Same dataset as the Connecticut contractor row. A DCP companion dataset, 'Real Estate Salespersons with Associated Broker' (6tja-6vdt, updated 2026-09-28), links salespersons to brokers; I found it in the catalog but did not open it.

authority: Delaware Dept. of Finance, Division of Revenue (contractor business licence, 30 Del. C. ch. 25); trades by Dept. of State, Division of Professional Regulation (Electrical Examiners; Plumbing/HVACR)
file_format: Socrata dataset (csv/json); dataset id 5zy2-grhr, 'Delaware Business Licenses'
approx_rows: approx 69,100 business licences in total; category RESIDENT CONTRACTOR approx 8,700, NON-RESIDENT CONTRACTOR approx 4,600
notes: There is no general-contractor licence based on competency. The Division of Revenue page (https://revenue.delaware.gov/business-tax-forms/contractors-resident-and-non-resident/) requires any contractor to register and get a business licence; no exam is mentioned. It is a tax/business licence, so register_exists='yes' only in that sense, and you may prefer to class it as no_state_level_gc. Columns: business_name, trade_name, category, current_license_valid_from/to, address, license_number, geocoded_location; no status column (current licences only). Trades licensed at state level (electricians, master plumber, master HVACR) are in DPR dataset pjnv-eaih: https://data.delaware.gov/resource/pjnv-eaih.json, approx 354,000 rows, daily, Public Domain.

authority: Delaware Real Estate Commission, Dept. of State, Division of Professional Regulation
file_format: Socrata dataset (csv/json); dataset id pjnv-eaih, 'Professional and Occupational Licensing'
approx_rows: approx 354,000 across all professions; Real Estate approx 31,000 (Salesperson 13,776, Resident Salesperson 9,473, Broker 1,745, etc.)
notes: Filter profession_id='Real Estate'. Columns: last_name, first_name, combined_name, license_no, profession_id, license_type, city, state, zip_code, country, issue_date, expiration_date, disciplinary_action, license_status. Address is city/state/zip only. There is no brokerage or business name. A companion disciplinary dataset is dz6p-akeq.

authority: DC Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP), Basic Business License program (General Contractor/Construction Manager and Home Improvement Contractor endorsements)
file_format: ArcGIS FeatureServer layer (Open Data DC item 85bf98d3915f412c8a4de706f2d13513, 'Basic Business Licenses'; csv export on opendata.dc.gov)
approx_rows: approx 279,100 BBL records in total (incl. historical); BUSINESSACTIVITY 'General Contractor/Construction Manager (A, B, C,...' approx 12,700 and 'Home Improvement Contractor' approx 7,760, all statuses
notes: objectIdField is OBJECTID. There is no explicit licence-number field, only CUSTOMERNUMBER. Other columns: LICENSESTATUS, LICENSETYPE, LICENSESTARTDATE, LICENSEENDDATE, INITIALISSUEDATE, BUSINESSACTIVITY, CATEGORYSERVICETYPE ('Contractor and Construction Services'), PREMISEADDRESS, ENTITYNAME, ENTITYTRADENAME, owner and agent names, WARD/ANC/SSL, lat/long. There is no qualifier or county (DC has none). Includes historical, inactive and cancelled records. Also 'Home Improvement Salesperson'. The DC plumbing and electrical licences are occupational licences under DLCP, not assessed here.

authority: DC Real Estate Commission, Department of Licensing and Consumer Protection (DLCP), Occupational and Professional Licensing
approx_rows: not_established
notes: The Commission page (https://dlcp.dc.gov/page/real-estate-commission, fetched) links only a 'Verify a Occupational/Professional License' portal, with no roster download. The portal URL redirects to an Okta OAuth sign-in (accessdc.dcra.dc.gov), so I did not open it. No real-estate licensee dataset appears among the DCGISopendata ArcGIS items. Whether a list is available by FOIA request is not established.

authority: State Licensing Board for Residential and Commercial General Contractors (Georgia Secretary of State, Professional Licensing Boards Division)
file_format: text (with Excel import instructions and record layout)
approx_rows: not_established
terms: fee (per licence type: $50 active / $25 inactive seen for other professions; 'All Active Roster' $3000; no refunds)
notes: The GOALS roster order page states that rosters contain licence number, name, city, state, zip, county, issue date and expiration date, but no phone, email or personal mailing address (O.C.G.A. 43-1-2(k), 50-18-72(a)(20)(A)). Partial lists are not sold. The roster listing is paginated (54 pages) and I did not confirm a residential or general-contractor entry or its price. The board has residential and commercial general contractor divisions (created 2004). Free lookup: https://goals.sos.ga.gov/GASOSOneStop/s/licensee-search. Conditioned air, electrical, plumbing and low-voltage trades fall under a separate SOS board, not assessed.

authority: Georgia Real Estate Commission & Appraisers Board (GREC)
approx_rows: not_established
cadence: not_established (a third-party reference to a 'monthly' database order is unverified)
terms: fee ($200 for 'Database - Real Estate'; purchaser name and address required)
notes: The GREC purchase portal offers Real Estate, Appraiser and Instructor lists. The Real Estate option opens the form 'Database - Real Estate ($200)'. I did not submit it, so format and fields are not established. Individual lookup is at https://ata.grec.state.ga.us/Account/Search.
